summary: The response to the request if it has received at least the status code, undefined otherwise
description:
The .response property contains the response to the request if it has received at least the status code, undefined otherwise.

A response object is a non-sharable object. It provides the following properties:

.body.description: Body of the response. The type of the message is defined according to the dataType property. Undefined if the body has not been received yet

.headers.description: Headers of the response. Header names are returned in lowercase. <headername>.key = value (value can be a collection if the same key appears multiple times). Undefined if the headers have not been received yet.

.rawHeaders.description: Headers of the response. Header names are returned untouched (with their original case). <headerName>.key = value (value can be a collection if the same key appears multiple times). Undefined if the headers have not been received yet.
